data.description: 2BR | Full Sea View | Burj Khalifa View
data.long_description:
Experience refined urban living in this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence spanning 1,480.25 sqft, thoughtfully designed to combine comfort, elegance, and functionality. Located in a prime and highly sought-after community, this home offers an excellent opportunity for both end-users and those seeking strong long-term value in a premium setting.

The layout is intelligently designed to maximize space and natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout the unit. The expansive living and dining area provides a seamless flow, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining guests. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance the sense of openness while offering a pleasant community view.

Both bedrooms are generously sized, featuring built-in wardrobes and well-planned layouts that ensure privacy and comfort. The master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom finished with high-quality fittings, while the second bathroom is equally modern and stylish, designed for convenience and functionality.

The kitchen is sleek and modern, fitted with quality cabinetry and practical storage solutions, making it ideal for daily use and easy meal preparation. Premium finishes throughout the apartment add a refined touch, enhancing the overall sense of luxury living.

Features:

⦁ 2 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms
⦁ 1,480.25 sqft built-up area
⦁ Spacious open-plan living and dining area
⦁ Bright interiors with large windows
⦁ Built-in wardrobes
⦁ Modern kitchen with quality finishes
⦁ Master bedroom with en-suite bathroom
⦁ High-quality flooring and fittings
⦁ Well-maintained unit

Amenities:

⦁ Swimming pool
⦁ Fully equipped gymnasium
⦁ 24/7 security and CCTV
⦁ Covered parking
⦁ High-speed elevators
⦁ Landscaped community areas
⦁ Family-friendly environment
⦁ Close to retail, dining, and daily conveniences
⦁ Easy access to main roads and transport links

This residence offers a perfect balance of style, space, and convenience in a prime location. A strong choice for comfortable living or a high-potential investment, delivering excellent lifestyle value in a modern urban setting.
